Week 21 Box Office — May 22, 2026

Current India box office rankings for Week 21 of 2026 (May 18–24).

Drishyam 3

Malayalam thriller released May 21 2026 on Mohanlal's 66th birthday. Day 1 collection ₹15.85 crore India nett, ₹18.37 crore India gross, ₹25 crore overseas. Worldwide opening ₹43.37 crore. Biggest Malayalam opening of 2026. 6th-highest-grossing Malayalam film of 2026 after a single day. Directed by Jeethu Joseph. Stars Mohanlal as Georgekutty. Budget approximately ₹100 crore. Hindi version with Ajay Devgn releases October 2 2026 (Gandhi Jayanti) with a divergent screenplay — Akshaye Khanna has been replaced by Jaideep Ahlawat as a new character. Producer Kumar Mangat Pathak confirmed Hindi audience taste differs and the Hindi version will follow a different track.

Drishyam 3 box office tracker May 22–24 weekend preview

Karuppu

Tamil mythological action drama released May 15 2026. Week 1 lifetime collection ₹109.62 crore India nett, ₹126.99 crore India gross, approximately ₹175 crore worldwide. Overseas ₹54 crore (~30%+ of WW). First Tamil 2026 release to cross ₹100 crore India nett. Suriya's biggest film ever. Directed by RJ Balaji. Stars Suriya, Trisha Krishnan, Indrans, Yogi Babu. Budget ₹130 crore. Verdict: Blockbuster.

Karuppu box office tracker

Chand Mera Dil

Hindi romantic musical drama releasing May 22 2026. Dharma Productions. Directed by Vivek Soni. Stars Ananya Panday and Lakshya in lead roles. Music by Vishal-Shekhar and Karan Nawani, with Shreya Ghoshal title track. ₹149 morning ticket pricing strategy. Advance booking sold approximately 9,000 tickets across PVR, Cinepolis, and Miraj national chains by Wednesday May 20. Day 1 opening forecast ₹4–6 crore India nett (base case). Tests Dharma's mid-budget romance template after Tu Meri Main Tera's ₹48 crore WW loss against ₹90 crore budget.

Chand Mera Dil box office tracker

Raja Shivaji

Marathi-Hindi historical epic released May 1 2026. Day 20 worldwide gross ₹102.51 crore. Second Marathi film ever to cross ₹100 crore worldwide gross. Most expensive Marathi production ever made (₹100 crore budget). Riteish Deshmukh as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. ₹100 crore India nett milestone within reach. Currently earning approximately ₹1.27 crore per day on weekday 20.

Raja Shivaji box office tracker

Pati Patni Aur Woh Do

Hindi romantic comedy sequel released May 15 2026. Week 1 lifetime ₹29 crore India nett, ₹34.43 crore India gross, ₹40.28 crore worldwide. Original Pati Patni Aur Woh (2019) collected ₹55.97 crore in week 1 alone — the sequel tracking roughly 48% behind. Stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, Wamiqa Gabbi, Rakulpreet Singh. Directed by Mudassar Aziz.

Pati Patni Aur Woh Do box office tracker

Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

Hollywood IMAX release dated May 22 2026 in English and Hindi-dub. First Star Wars theatrical film in 7 years since The Rise of Skywalker (2019). Directed by Jon Favreau. Stars Pedro Pascal. Global tracking $82 million domestic opening, $160 million worldwide. India forecast ₹3–6 crore D1, ₹10–18 crore W1.

Bhooth Bangla

Hindi horror-comedy released April 17 2026. Week 6 lifetime worldwide ₹188.49 crore. Akshay Kumar, Tabu, Wamiqa Gabbi, Jisshu Sengupta, Paresh Rawal. Directed by Priyadarshan. Budget ₹120 crore. Verdict: Hit. Long-tail performer.
